verdict.rationale: Org-wide admin policy enforcement is a fair axis for an authenticator app. The evidence only shows user-controlled settings, such as the optional Privacy Screen that a user can turn on. Nothing documents an admin console or any way to enforce app lock, restrict export or mandate credentials across members' apps.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
